## Unstuck 0.5.0: shell commands for agent-browser and other CLI browsers

Agents that drive a browser one shell command at a time, like [agent-browser](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-browser), can now bring a person in at a CAPTCHA, a login wall or a 2FA prompt, and carry on in the same tab.

### New
- **`unstuck` shell commands.** `npm install -g @velmlabs/unstuck-engine` now also installs an `unstuck` command (same program as `unstuck-engine`). Every command prints one JSON line and exits with a code the agent can branch on:

  | Exit | Status |
  |---|---|
  | `0` | `clear`, `resolved`, `answered` |
  | `10` | `human_needed`: show the person the link, then `unstuck wait <id>` |
  | `11` | `waiting`: run `unstuck wait <id>` again |
  | `20` | `check_found` |
  | `30` | `failed`, `cancelled`, `timed_out`, `still_blocked`, `rescue_limited`… |
  | `2` | usage or setup problem (`no_cdp`, `several_tabs`, `tab_not_found`, `too_many_requests`…) |

- **The loop:** `unstuck check` after each navigation, `unstuck rescue` when it finds a check, then `unstuck wait <id>` until the person is done.
  - `--cdp` takes the browser's DevTools address (`agent-browser get cdp-url`, `http://127.0.0.1:9222`, `host:port`, or a `ws://` browser or page URL), or `UNSTUCK_CDP_URL`.
  - `--tab <targetId>` picks the tab (`agent-browser tab list --json` lists them). With several tabs open and no `--tab`, the command stops with `several_tabs` and lists them.
  - `--url <the URL the agent opened>` lets a redirect to a sign-in page count as a login wall.
- **`unstuck takeover --reason "…"`** hands the tab to the person for anything only they can do. **`unstuck ask "…" --choice A --choice B`** asks a question without a page. **`unstuck cancel <id>`** ends a request.
- **A request outlives the command that started it.** A small background process holds it, so a `wait` killed by the agent's shell (Claude Code stops commands after 10 minutes) doesn't end it. `wait` returns within 45 s by default (`--max-wait` up to 120) and can be run again.
  - One request per tab, at most three running at once. A request frees its tab as soon as it ends; its result stays readable for `wait` for 10 minutes.
  - A second `rescue` on a tab that already has one returns the same link.
  - The background process listens on 127.0.0.1 only, behind a random token; its files live in `~/.unstuck/run` (0700/0600).
- **The 6-digit code** (`UNSTUCK_REQUIRE_CODE=1`) goes only to the person's phone alerts, never to the agent; it needs Unstuck Cloud alerts.
- **Skill and docs.** The Unstuck skill has a "Shell agents and agent-browser" section. New guide: [unstuck.sh/docs/agent-browser](https://unstuck.sh/docs/agent-browser/). Example: `examples/agent-browser/`.

### Fixed
- The check that a browser can show CAPTCHA widgets now gives up after 10 seconds on a tab that never paints, and reports "unknown" instead of waiting forever.
